The '''''Eviscerator''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The ''Eviscerator'' patrolled the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. During the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]], the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]] was stationed aboard the ''Eviscerator''.

After the fall of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], the ''Eviscerator'' was reassigned to patrol in the [[Mirit system/Legends|Mirit]], [[Pyria system|Pyria]] and [[Venjagga system/Legends|Venjagga]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]] [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Liberator'']] and ''[[Emancipator]]'' were used as a feint at [[Ord Mirit]] in order to lure the ''Eviscerator'' far from the [[Second Battle of Borleias]].
